name: theme
title: Mokei theme
description: Glass + clay tokens and the Tailwind v4 preset. Sets CSS variables so Mokei components pick up the look.
docs: Import the copied preset from your CSS after Tailwind: `@import "./mokei/preset.css";` or rely on the injected CSS variables. Add `@mokei` as `https://stephenshorton.github.io/mokei/r/{name}.json` to use `npx shadcn add @mokei/button`.
